label: EvalAI
terms_note: EvalAI REST API (OpenAPI schema at https://eval.ai/api/schema/, Redoc at /api/docs/). Auth token from your EvalAI profile, sent as a Bearer token (the schema's jwtAuth).

fields.name: auth_token
fields.help: EvalAI auth token from https://eval.ai/web/profile ('Get your Auth Token'; the token the evalai CLI uses). Sent as Authorization: Bearer.

config_fields.name: participant_team_id
config_fields.help: Numeric id of your EvalAI participant team (from GET /api/participants/participant_team or the Participant Teams page); needed only by `enter`.

adapter.rate_note: Endpoints are throttled (DRF UserRateThrottle/AnonRateThrottle) without published numbers. One request per second.

me.note: GET /api/auth/user/: pk, username, email, first_name, last_name.

discover.note: GET /api/challenges/challenge/{challenge_time}/{approved}/{published} with present/approved/public fixed: ongoing public challenges. The server pages (`page`, fixed size); `limit` is not sent and there is no text filter, so `query`, `kind` and `status` are not sent. short_description, is_registration_open and has_prize stay in `raw`.

get_competition.note: GET /api/challenges/challenge/{id}/. `description` and `submission_format` (submission_guidelines) are HTML; terms_and_conditions, evaluation_details and is_registration_open stay in `raw`. Phase splits (the leaderboard ids) are at GET /api/challenges/{challenge_pk}/challenge_phase_split (not mapped).

standings.note: Leaderboards are per challenge-phase split: pass the phase-split id (from /api/challenges/{challenge_pk}/challenge_phase_split) as `competition_id`, not the challenge id. Rows come in leaderboard order; `score` is the default-order metric (filtering_score) and the full metric vector is `raw.result` with labels in `raw.leaderboard__schema`.

enter.note: POST /api/challenges/challenge/{challenge_pk}/participant_team/{participant_team_pk}: registers your team (config `participant_team_id`) for the challenge; answers 201 with no body. Closed registration, email-domain rules and team-size limits come back as 406 errors.

not_offered.my_entries: Participant submissions are listed per phase (GET /api/jobs/challenge/{challenge_id}/challenge_phase/{challenge_phase_id}/submission/); the vocabulary has no phase id, and /api/jobs/challenge/{challenge_pk}/submission/ is host-only.
not_offered.submit: POST /api/jobs/challenge/{challenge_id}/challenge_phase/{challenge_phase_id}/submission/ takes a multipart `input_file` (or a presigned-URL upload); binary uploads are out of scope.

evidence: probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 200 (public), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 4/5 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; names not found on the page: discover:page, standings:page
live read without credentials: discover returned data that validates against the vocabulary
